responsibility: Provides the procedural-macro invocation parser instantiations needed for gccrs by explicitly emitting selected `Parser<ProcMacroInvocLexer>` entry points, notably item and statement parsing. In the Rust parsing subsystem this file connects the generic parser implementation to the token source used for proc-macro invocations, so AST fragments can be parsed from procedural-macro token streams without instantiating the full parser class here; it is therefore the specialized compilation unit for proc-macro parsing support, distinct from the full normal-source and macro-invocation parser instantiations.
